INSTALLATION MATRIX

Deploy Taskee to Your Machine

Taskee is distributed as a zero-dependency standalone binary for both Windows and Linux, as well as a one-liner install for Rust developers via Cargo.

Standalone Windows Executable (.exe)

No installer, no administrative privileges required. Run directly from anywhere.

DIRECT DOWNLOAD (taskee.exe) GITHUB RELEASES
POWERSHELL DOWNLOAD & LAUNCH 
# Download standalone executable via PowerShell
PS> Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://github.com/alrifatsabbir/taskee/releases/latest/download/taskee-windows-x86_64.exe" -OutFile "taskee.exe"

# Launch Taskee immediately
PS> .\taskee.exe
Compatibility: Windows 10, Windows 11, Windows Server 2019+ (64-bit). Direct3D 12 / Vulkan / Software fallback supported.

Linux Standalone ELF Binary

Compiled with static linking for universal distribution across Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch, Debian, and WSL.

DOWNLOAD BINARY (x86_64)
BASH DOWNLOAD & PERMISSIONS 
# Fetch binary and grant execute permissions
$ curl -L -o taskee https://github.com/alrifatsabbir/taskee/releases/latest/download/taskee-linux-x86_64
$ chmod +x taskee

# Standard Linux execution
$ ./taskee

# WSL / Headless software OpenGL fallback (if no hardware acceleration)
$ LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE=1 ./taskee

Global Installation via Cargo

For users with the Rust toolchain installed, install globally into your system path in one command.

TERMINAL / PROMPT 
# Install Taskee globally via Git
> cargo install --git https://github.com/alrifatsabbir/taskee

# Once completed, launch anywhere:
> taskee
ADVANTAGE
Target CPU Optimization

Compiles against your machine's exact CPU instruction set for maximum execution efficiency.

GLOBAL BIN
Path Integration

Automatically added to ~/.cargo/bin, available across PowerShell, Bash, Zsh, and CMD.

Building from Source Code

Clone the repository and compile using the optimized release profile.

SOURCE COMPILATION 
# 1. Clone repository
$ git clone https://github.com/alrifatsabbir/taskee.git
$ cd taskee

# 2. Build and run desktop monitor
$ cargo run --release

# 3. Or build and run the Taskee website locally
$ cd website && cargo run --release
HARDWARE REQUIREMENTS

Workstation System Requirements

Operating System

• Windows 10 (1903+) or Windows 11 (x86_64)
• Linux (Kernel 5.4+, glibc 2.31+, WSL2)

Memory & Storage

• RAM: 15 MB free physical memory
• Disk: 18 MB standalone binary size

Graphics Acceleration

• Vulkan, DirectX 12, or OpenGL 3.3+
• Software rasterizer supported via Mesa / WARP
